data: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.
Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.
Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.
Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.
Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.
When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.
Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.
Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.
Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.
Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.
Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.
Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.
Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.
Targets can only be hit once per multishot.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.
While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.
Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.
Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
-28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime
Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers
300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early.
Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s
Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.
+20.0 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.
You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies.
The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback.
When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies.
Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.
If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.
Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.
Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.
Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.
Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.
Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.
+150.0 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling
Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal
Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
+20m Cast Range and gain +7.0 Weapon Damage for 6s
Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
+3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage.
While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant.
Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.
Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.
Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.
Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.
Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.
Can be recast within a brief window.
On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets
Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage.
Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
Silences enemies for 2s if close range

Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.
Can be shot to detonate early.
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
Active: Bullets are amplified against wrecked enemies. Using melee boosts max health and extends duration.
+1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.
After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage.
The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
+1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in
